query: I have to present our caching redesign to the architecture council next Thursday. Read the RFC, work out the argument and trade-offs, then give me a timed slide-by-slide content brief and likely Q&A. Don't make the PowerPoint yet.
turn this 18-page research paper into a 12 minute conference talk for a mixed controls and industry audience. I need the story, what evidence to show, what to cut, and speaker intent.
Our all-hands deck is technically accurate but completely flat. Rebuild the narrative so people understand why the operating model is changing and what they need to do afterward.
Help me plan a pitch to the investment committee. They know the business problem but not the architecture; I need funding for phase two without hiding the migration risk.
Review presentation-outline.md and tell me why the story doesn't land. Then repair the sequence, titles, evidence, opening and ending. Content only.
I need two versions of this technical talk: a 10-minute executive briefing and a 30-minute engineering deep dive. Show exactly how audience, evidence and ask change.
plan a 45 min training presentation on incident hypothesis testing, including a worked example, audience practice and how I'll know they learned it
Create the narrative and production brief for a 7-minute live product demo. Include what the speaker says, what appears on screen, transitions and a fallback if the API fails.
Before you generate the slides, develop the governing idea, audience change, story spine, claim/evidence map and beat plan for this keynote.
This board presentation claims our AI pilot improved productivity from one month of PR counts. Make the argument intellectually honest and tell us what rollout decision the evidence supports.
Take this approved slide-by-slide production brief and create the actual branded PowerPoint file. Do not change wording, order, story, or speaker notes.
Fix the font embedding and broken image links in quarterly-review.pptx without changing any presentation content.
Design a visual theme for our existing deck: colours, type scale, background motifs and slide masters. The narrative is already approved.
Extract all text and speaker notes from this PowerPoint into markdown, preserving slide order exactly.
Coach me through stage fright and breathing before tomorrow's talk. I do not need help with content or structure.
Write a six-page technical RFC for this migration. It will be read asynchronously and no presentation is planned.
Summarise the board meeting transcript and list decisions, actions and owners. Nobody is presenting it.
Create a 90-second social media video script announcing the feature. It isn't part of a live talk or slide presentation.
Generate three chart images from the supplied CSV using the exact titles and chart types in the design spec.
Proofread the final keynote transcript for grammar only. The argument and structure are locked and must not change.
